pyFBS.VPT¶

class pyFBS.VPT(ch, refch, vp_ch, vp_refch, Wu=None, Wf=None, sort_matrix=True)[source]¶

Virtual Point Transformation (VPT) - enables transformation of measured responses to a virtual DoFs. Current implementation enables rigid interface deformation modes and all 6 DoFs (3 translations + 3 rotations), have to be included in the transformation.

Parameters

  • ch (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on channels (i.e. outputs)

  • refch (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on reference channels (i.e. inputs)

  • vp_ch (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on virtual point channels

  • vp_refch (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on reference virtual point channels

  • Wu (array(float), optional) – Displacement weigting matrix

  • Wf (array(float), optional) – Force weighting matrix

  • sort_matrix (bool, optional) –

static R_matrix_F(pos)[source]¶

Calculates Rf matrix based on the reference channel position/orientation.

Parameters

pos (array(float)) – Position of the reference channel relative to the virtual point.

Returns

Rf matrix

static R_matrix_U(pos, type='Acceleration')[source]¶

Calculate Ru matrix based on the channel position/orientation and sensor type.

Parameters

  • pos (string, optional) – Position of the channel.

  • type – Type of the channel (i.e. Acceleration or Angular Acceleration).

Returns

Ru matrix

static W_rotational(pos, dir, type='Angular Acceleration')[source]¶

Defines the weighting matrix based on the location of rotational accelerometer

Parameters

  • pos (array(float)) – Position of the channel.

  • dir (array(float)) – Direction of the channel

  • type (str, optional) – Type of the channel (i.e. Acceleration or Angular Acceleration)

apply_VPT(freq, FRF)[source]¶

Applies the Virtual Point Transformation on the FRF matrix.

Parameters

  • freq (array(float)) – Frequency vector

  • FRF (array(float)) – A matrix of Frequency Response Functions FRFs [f,out,in].

consistency(grouping, ref_grouping)[source]¶

Evaluates VP consistency indicators based on the supplied grouping numbers.

Parameters

  • grouping (float) – Grouping number of the VP.

  • ref_grouping (float) – Grouping number of the reference VP.

define_IDM_F()[source]¶

Calculates the Rf, Tf, Ff matrices based on the supplied position and orientation of Reference Channels and Reference Virtual Channels.

define_IDM_U()[source]¶

Calculates Ru, Tu and Fu matrices based on the supplied position and orientation of Channels and Virtual Channels.
